title: Open Policy Agent：拒絕預設與授權真值表
titleEn: Open Policy Agent: default deny and authorization truth tables
subcategoryTitle: 身分保證、授權與零信任架構
subcategoryTitleEn: Identity assurance, authorization and zero-trust architecture
summary: 建立三個角色、四種資源、兩種動作的授權矩陣；先把需要允許的格子明確列出，缺值與未知角色走拒絕。
summaryEn: Build an authorization matrix with three roles, four resources and two actions; enumerate allowed cells explicitly and deny missing values or unknown roles.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。建立三個角色、四種資源、兩種動作的授權矩陣；先把需要允許的格子明確列出，缺值與未知角色走拒絕。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。

Build an authorization matrix with three roles, four resources and two actions; enumerate allowed cells explicitly and deny missing values or unknown roles. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: OPA 的Rego以結構化資料作政策決策，可把授權邏輯與服務實作分離。
knowledge.textEn: OPA uses Rego over structured data to separate authorization policy from service implementation.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立三個角色、四種資源、兩種動作的授權矩陣；先把需要允許的格子明確列出，缺值與未知角色走拒絕。
knowledge.textEn: Build an authorization matrix with three roles, four resources and two actions; enumerate allowed cells explicitly and deny missing values or unknown roles.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 完整笛卡兒積測試數=角色數×資源數×動作數；測試覆蓋不等於每格都允許，缺少測試也不能解讀為拒絕正確。
knowledge.textEn: Complete Cartesian tests equal roles×resources×actions; coverage does not mean every case allows, and an untested cell is not a proven denial.
